drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached please find Defendant Delmar’s proposed draft Confidential Settlement Agreement. We have included standard provisions regarding payment timing, dismissal, a mutual confidentiality framework, no admission of liability, and a release tied to receipt of settlement funds.

Please send any comments or proposed revisions at your convenience. We believe this draft should provide a practical path to documentation and closure.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.name: scrub privileged/internal alt-text and concealed content

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to fully and finally resolve all claims, disputes, and causes of action asserted or that could have been asserted relating to the matters alleged in the Action, without any admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after Defendant’s receipt of: (a) a fully executed copy of this Agreement; (b) a completed and executed IRS Form W-9 from Plaintiff; and (c) wire or payment instructions reasonably acceptable to Defendant. Plaintiff shall be solely responsible for any taxes, liens, allocations, or reporting obligations arising from receipt of the Settlement Amount, and Defendant makes no representation regarding the tax treatment of the Settlement Amount.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s heirs, successors, assigns, representatives, agents, attorneys, and all persons or entities claiming through Plaintiff, fully and forever releases Defendant and its past, present, and future parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, attorneys, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, actions, causes of action, damages, costs, fees, expenses, and liabilities of any kind, whether known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, arising out of or relating to the matters alleged in the Action. Within three (3) business days after receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal of the Action with prejudice, with each party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: release and dismissal

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The existence, terms, amount, negotiations, and circumstances of this Agreement shall be kept strictly confidential by the parties and their counsel, except that disclosure may be made: (a) to a party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, and immediate family members who have a legitimate need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) as required by law, regulation, court order, subpoena, or tax reporting obligation; or (c) as necessary to enforce this Agreement. If disclosure is required by legal process, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permissible, provide prompt notice so the other party may seek protective treatment. The parties shall not make any public statement concerning this Agreement other than that the matter has been resolved.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement, the negotiations leading to it, and any payment made under it are a compromise of disputed claims and are not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, damages, or the validity of any claim or defense by Defendant, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: no admission

edits.text: 5. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. Plaintiff shall not make, publish, or communicate any false or disparaging statement concerning Defendant or its officers, directors, employees, agents, business, products, or services. Nothing in this provision prohibits truthful testimony compelled by law or communications protected by applicable law.
edits.name: non-disparagement

edits.text: 6. AUTHORITY; ENTIRE AGREEMENT. Each person signing this Agreement represents that the person has full authority to bind the party on whose behalf the person signs. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous agreements, understandings, or communications concerning that subject matter. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by all parties.
edits.name: authority and integration

edits.text: 7. GOVERNING LAW; ENFORCEMENT. This Agreement shall be governed by the law of the state in which the Action is pending, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. The court in which the Action is pending shall retain jurisdiction to enforce the Agreement to the extent permitted by law. In any action to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs.
edits.name: governing law and enforcement

edits.text: 8. COUNTERPARTS; ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together constitute one instrument. Signatures transmitted electronically or by PDF shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes.
edits.name: counterparts

edits.name: Recitals - action-limited resolution

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of $[INSERT SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] (the “Settlement Amount”) within five (5) business days after Defendant’s receipt of: (a) a fully executed copy of this Agreement; (b) a completed and executed IRS Form W-9 from Plaintiff; and (c) wire or payment instructions reasonably acceptable to Defendant. Payment shall be deemed received when funds have cleared in Plaintiff’s counsel’s trust account or other account designated in writing by Plaintiff. Plaintiff shall be solely responsible for any taxes, liens, allocations, or reporting obligations arising from receipt of the Settlement Amount. edits.name: Payment - 5 business days and tax neutrality

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Upon receipt of cleared funds for the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s heirs, successors, assigns, representatives, agents, attorneys, and all persons or entities claiming through Plaintiff, fully and forever releases Defendant and its past, present, and future parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, attorneys, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, actions, causes of action, damages, costs, fees, expenses, and liabilities of any kind, whether known or unknown, asserted or unasserted, that were asserted in the Action or arise out of or relate to the matters alleged in the Action. For avoidance of doubt, this release does not release claims unrelated to the Action or to the matters alleged in the Action. Within three (3) business days after receipt of cleared funds for the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal of the Action with prejudice, with each party to bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs except as expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: Release and dismissal - action-limited, cleared funds

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and amount of this Agreement shall be kept confidential by the parties and their counsel, except that disclosure may be made: (a) to a party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, and immediate family members who have a legitimate need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) as required by law, regulation, court order, subpoena, or tax reporting obligation; (c) to any court or tribunal as necessary to enforce this Agreement; or (d) to the extent the information becomes public through no breach of this Agreement by the disclosing party. If disclosure is required by legal process, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permissible, provide prompt notice so the other party may seek protective treatment. The parties shall not make any public statement concerning the terms or amount of this Agreement other than that the matter has been resolved.
edits.name: Confidentiality - limited to terms and amount

edits.text: 4. MUTUAL NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree that they will not make, publish, or communicate to any third party any knowingly false or disparaging statement concerning the other party, the Action, or the matters alleged in the Action. This provision does not prohibit truthful statements required by law, regulation, subpoena, court order, or other legal process, nor does it prohibit communications with counsel, tax advisors, accountants, insurers, auditors, or immediate family members consistent with the confidentiality provision of this Agreement.
edits.name: Mutual non-disparagement

edits.text: 5. ENFORCEMENT; PREVAILING-PARTY FEES. In any action or proceeding to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement, in addition to any other relief available at law or in equity.
edits.name: Prevailing-party enforcement fees

edits.text: 6. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims. Neither this Agreement nor any payment or performance under it constitutes or shall be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, damages, or any legal or factual contention by any party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No admission

edits.text: 7. AUTHORITY; ENTIRE AGREEMENT. Each person signing this Agreement represents that they have authority to do so and to bind the party on whose behalf they sign. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous discussions, negotiations, and agreements concerning that subject matter. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by all parties.
edits.name: Authority and entire agreement

edits.text: 8. COUNTERPARTS; ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together constitute one instrument. Signatures transmitted electronically or by PDF shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes.
edits.name: Counterparts renumbered
